spec.name: Furniture Haunted Mirror
spec.description: A freestanding dark-oak gothic mirror with sturdy splayed-width feet, a stepped crown, sculpted bat crest and mysterious violet glass. Front faces negative Z. All geometry is axis-aligned, physically connected and contained within the requested furniture bounds.

prompt: Create an original vanilla Minecraft furniture model: standing gothic mirror with dark frame, bat crest and mysterious purple glass. Grounded attractive survival-server furniture. Entire model fits x=0..16, y=0..32, z=0..16; floor y=0, front negative Z. 16 units per Minecraft block. Keep a 0.25-unit margin at outer x/z edges.  Use 8-30 purposeful axis-aligned cuboids, no rotations, no bones, no animation. Detailed hand-painted pixel art, coherent palette, explicit non-overlapping cube-net UVs with correct texel density. Connected physical structure, no z fighting, no stand outside the furniture. No text labels, no surrounding scene. Generate the whole piece with its distinctive silhouette and materials.
